body.message:
Hi there! Good day.

My name is Omar JarrahPasha. I’m reaching out to introduce myself for potential opportunities within Fam Living’s operations, guest relations, or portfolio development teams.

I bring over 10 years of hands-on experience in short-stay property management, OTA distribution (Booking.com), and high-ticket GCC client sales. As a hospitality founder and property manager, I have overseen full property lifecycles—from unit setup and listing creation to guest operations, multi-team logistics, and revenue optimization.

Based in Dubai and fluent in *English, Arabic, and Turkish*, I specialize in high-touch guest relations and managing high-demand portfolios under pressure.

I have attached my *CV* and *Cover Letter* here for your review. I would welcome the opportunity to connect and discuss how my background can support Fam Living’s expanding holiday home portfolio.

Thank you for your time!

Best regards,

*Omar JarrahPasha*

📱 +90 501 005 0001

✉️ omar.jarrahpasha@gmail.com
